meaning_english: One who carries a stick, doorkeeper, ascetic

meaning_sanskrit: दण्डः अस्य अस्ति सः, सन्न्यासी, नृपः, द्वारपालः

meaning_english: One who is proud, bold or courageous
One that happens in ten days

meaning_sanskrit: (1) पादबन्धरज्जुम् आस्वादयति सः दामलिट् । सामान्यतः अश्वः, वृषभः इत्यादिः कश्चन पशुः ।(2) एतादृशम् (पशुम्) आत्मनः कृते इच्छति सः अपि दामलिट् एव ।
meaning_english: (1) One who licks a rope (tied to its legs). Typically a cattle, horse etc.  (2) A person who desires such an animal for himself.
One who is desirous of burning
One that glows, one that shines
One that is born from vision
Goes in the direction of God
The one that scarifies to gods
One that happens in two days
